notes.title: Signup for future Spellomancer Playtests!
notes.content:
Sign up for Spellomancer Playtesting!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331777/eb580d7dacb2250148cb1180a7ac854804cfa358.gif

That's right, we'll be hosting playtest sessions in the near future, and you're invited! Fill out our Google Form for a chance to play before anyone else.

Oh, and join our Discord when you get the chance, too. You'll need to in order to participate! It's also just a real fun place to be. We even have a channel where you can share your favorite words! Some highlights include "mnemonic," "ebullient," and a lot of different pasta names that made me hungry.

While I'm here, I just wanted to thank you all for supporting our wordy lil action platformer. It's been a wild ride since we introduced the world to Spellomancer last month. We can't wait to show you even more of what we're working on soon!

Thanks for reading—and if you haven't wishlisted Spellomancer yet, please do so! It helps us more than you know!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2933760/Spellomancer
